steps: Download the Observa app and create an account with your PayPal email
Browse opportunities near you showing pay
Accept an opportunity and complete it within 2 hours
Take required photos in the app and answer questions
Get paid via PayPal usually within 5 days of approval
timing: Paid via PayPal, usually within 5 days of approval. No minimum payout threshold.

repeatable.cadence: There is no limit on how many opportunities you can do — grab new ones off the map as they appear and get paid for each approved observation.

maximize: Only accept an opportunity you can finish within 2 hours — late work pays zero. There is no minimum to cash out, so every approved observation lands in your PayPal in about 5 days.
who_pays: Observa pays you through the app for each approved observation, sent to your PayPal account.
who_qualifies: US or Canada, with a smartphone and the Observa app, plus a PayPal account — PayPal is the only payout method, so without one you cannot get paid.
work_available: Opportunities appear on the in-app map near you, with email and push alerts when new ones post. The catch: store lists and gig frequency are chosen by Observa's retail customers, so if your area isn't on their list you'll see very few gigs. There is no guaranteed volume.
what_gets_accepted: Payment is issued only after your submission passes validation: you must be at the correct location, answer every question completely per the instructions, and take all photos inside the Observa app — camera-roll uploads and emailed photos are not accepted. You have exactly 2 hours after accepting to finish; late, incomplete, or rejected observations pay nothing.
costs_and_unpaid_time: No joining fee. Unpaid time: browsing and accepting opportunities, traveling to stores, and completing each observation (15–30 minutes) under the 2-hour clock. Don't game the system — accepting and re-accepting the same opportunity ('squatting') can get you warned or banned.
when_cash_arrives: Payment is issued automatically to your PayPal right after your submission is validated — usually within 5 days, longer on weekends and holidays. There is no minimum balance to cash out.
reject_reason: offline/in-person — catalog is online-only per owner 2026-09-23
